desc: Derive a full-grid combinatorial count and an exact, non-overlapping first-entry decomposition for paths that visit the removed rectangle; obtain summation formulas that can be evaluated in O(W+H) time, including all boundary-degenerate cases.
Precompute factorials and inverse factorials up to W+H for binomial coefficients modulo 998244353.
Implement the derived formula in Python with stdin/stdout handling and verify edge cases such as holes on outer boundaries, single-row/column holes, and zero-length paths.
